alkylation reagent: followed by treated with 50 mM 2-chloroacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3
alkylation concentration: followed by treated with 50 mM 2-chloroacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3
cleavage agent: rehydrated with 50 mM NH4HCO3 solution containing 20 ng/μl trypsin for digestion overnight
collision energy: with a collision energy of 35% and an activation time of 0.1 ms
instrument: MS analysis was performed on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: The spray voltage was set at 2.2 kV
labeling: Label-free tandem mass spectrometry was used to map the sites of ubiquitination in NDP52, OPTN, and SQSTM1
reduction reagent: treated with reducing agent TCEP in 100 mM NH4HCO3
